description: A single mj-html-attributes selector: a CSS path and the custom HTML attributes to apply. Carried for lossless round-trip; the default renderer (Mjml.Net) does not emit it (see E0.9).

members.name: Attributes
members.description: Gets the custom HTML attributes to apply to matching elements.

members.name: Path
members.description: Gets or sets the CSS selector path (mj-selector path).
